verdict: Product Master already has almost all website filter facets. Gaps are mostly search/extraction wiring + one missing field (discount %). Ready-to-ship on the site is NOT QuickShipStatus.

filters.notes: Site count ~13795. QuickShipStatus=True is only 343 — that is NOT site ready-to-ship. Our sync uses LiveStatus∧Published as flags.inStock (~14490). Inventory is always >0 in this dump.
filters.improve: Optional QuickShipStatus filter for true quick-ship; keep inStock as Live+Published.

filters.website: SIZE (ft.) including dia round / runner / square / oversize
filters.notes: SizeGroupInFT already buckets 8X10, Runner, Oversize Rugs, 6 Dia Round, etc. — matches site taxonomy closely.
filters.improve: Prefer SizeGroupInFT for size filters (not only SizeInFT regex). Map '6 dia round', runner, square, oversize rugs to SizeGroupInFT tokens.

filters.notes: DisplayFilter sparse (2.6%). Site color chips align more with ColorFamily / DisplayFilter than yarn %. Catalog-first search already addresses this.
filters.improve: Expand alias map to site chip names (Cyan, Grey spelling). Use ColorFamily carefully for single-color vs mixture.

filters.website: MATERIAL (wool, wool and bamboo silk, afghan wool…)
filters.notes: MaterialFamilies matches site list better (Afghan Wool, Jute and Hemp, Tencil, PET).
filters.improve: Index/search MaterialFamilies as primary material facet; keep Material as secondary.

filters.notes: All currency MRP fields present. We already support price_filter; can hardcode site INR bucket presets.
filters.improve: Named buckets: under 20k / 20–50k / … / above 3L for LLM+regex.

filters.notes: Rectangle, Irregular, Runner, Round, Square, Oval, OCT — matches site.
Hand Knotted / Hand Tufted / Hand Loom / Flat Weaves / Shag present (case noise).
Modern / Traditional / Transitional — case duplicates in raw data.
filters.improve: Ensure Style is a first-class attribute_filter (not only pattern/general).

filters.notes: Abstract, Floral and Tropical, Geometric and Stripes, Graphic and Art Deco, etc.
filters.improve: Broader pattern aliases for site labels (moroccan and tribal, oriental and traditional).

filters.notes: No Discount / DiscountPercent field on Product Master. ClearanceStatus exists (545 True) but is not % off.
filters.improve: Cannot support % discount from Product Master alone; need another JR endpoint or scrape. Optional ClearanceStatus filter only.

filters.notes: 1658 products have Designer (Kavi, Ashiesh Shah, Abin Chaudhary, …).
filters.improve: Explicit designer attribute + aliases; already in search_tokens via Designer field.

filters.notes: 100% present. Site names like Erbe / Uvenuti / Aalam match. Some site names may differ slightly (Manchaha vs Freedom Manchaha).
filters.improve: Collection as dedicated filter (exact/token), not buried in general text.
